target.name: check_expectations
target.content: def check_expectations(output_dir, manifest, base_url):     """Compare the batch bundle with the fixture corpus' retained bytes and labels."""     bundle = json.loads((Path(output_dir) / "bundle.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))     sources = {s["id"]: s for s in manifest["sources"]}     problems = []     outcomes = {o["key"]: o for o in bundle["outcomes"]}     if list(outcomes) != list(BATCH):         problems.append(f"E_LINEAGE: keys {list(outcomes)} != submitted {list(BATCH)}")     for key, (source_id, status, code) in BATCH.items():         outcome = outcomes.get(key)         if outcome is None:             continue         source = sources[source_id]         if outcome["requested_url"] != base_url + source["route"]:             problems.append(f"E_LINEAGE: {key} requested {outcome['requested_url']}")         if outcome["status"] != status or (outcome["diagnostic"] or {}).get("code") != code:             problems.append(f"E_OUTCOME: {key} is {outcome['status']}/{outcome['diagnostic']}, expected {status}/{code}")         if status != "success" or outcome["source_reference"] is None:             continue         final = sources[source["response"]["location"].strip("/")] if "location" in source["response"] else source         artifact = outcome["source_reference"]["artifact"]         if artifact["content_digest"] != final["sha256"]:             problems.append(f"E_SOURCE_DIGEST: {key} retained bytes differ from fixture {final['id']}")         if artifact["final_url"] != base_url + final["route"]:             problems.append(f"E_LINEAGE: {key} final_url {artifact['final_url']}")     empty, failure = outcomes.get("empty"), outcomes.get("failure")     if empty and (empty["text"] or empty["diagnostic"] is not None or empty["source_reference"] is None):         problems.append("E_ERROR_EMPTY: legitimate empty page is not an empty success with source proof")     if failure and (failure["source_reference"] is not None or failure["diagnostic"] is None):         problems.append("E_ERROR_EMPTY: HTTP failure is not an explicit error")     first, again = outcomes.get("static"), outcomes.get("static-again")     if first and again and first["source_reference"] and again["source_reference"]:         if first["source_reference"]["artifact"]["snapshot_id"] == again["source_reference"]["artifact"]["snapshot_id"]:             problems.append("E_LINEAGE: duplicate URL occurrences share one snapshot")     return problems
